objective: Add a provider-neutral sandbox execution plane with a real PandaStack adapter while preserving strict separation from Notebook, F06 worker authority, and F07 truth.
changes: Added provider-neutral SandboxProviderAdapter and runtime contracts.
Added PandaStack Hosted REST adapter for validation, provisioning, readiness, exec, reconciliation, and termination.
Sanitized provider error bodies so secrets and raw payloads do not escape through application exceptions.
Marked sandbox providers as ineligible for F06 worker promotion.
Added blocking Sandbox Fabric contract tests and workflow.
notes: PandaStack API operations follow documented v1 REST endpoints.
Provider-side idempotency is not assumed by the adapter.
Sandbox execution is not artifact acceptance; F07 remains authoritative.
No live provider credentials are committed.
verificationPlan: Pass blocking FactoryOS typecheck and Sandbox Fabric contract tests.
Pass Team Change Gate and affected-floor validation.
Merge only after all required blocking lanes are green.
